objective_checks.detail: all pinned refs carry version comments

dimensions.name: Completeness
dimensions.rationale: All four remote action refs were pinned across both workflow files — including the second, easily-missed `actions/checkout` in the lint job — each to a full 40-char SHA with a version+date comment.

dimensions.name: Restraint
dimensions.rationale: The local composite action and the `docker://` reference were correctly left unpinned, and no unrelated files or lines were touched.

dimensions.name: Communication
dimensions.rationale: The agent clearly stated what it pinned and gave sound reasoning for the cooling-off downgrade of checkout, but it described version/date comments rather than explaining the concrete method used to confirm each SHA maps to its tag.
